title: Minimal CLI surface contract
source_of_truth: docs/adr/runner-language.md (Accepted, 2026-09-21): the CLI is Go and always goes through the control plane, never the Runner directly

issue #14: acceptance criteria and the 2026-10-02 note (cp interface/implementation carried by the #20 integration; API gaps answer explicit unsupported, never a mocked success; #76 native control-plane dependency)
docs/plan.md section 3/4: M1 minimal commands login, claude, ls, connect, suspend, exec and the download-only sandbox cp
scripts/clone_args.py validate_repo_url: the repo URL rule referenced by sandbox claude --repo

binary.name: sandbox
binary.implementation_status: not started: no Go toolchain in this repo slice and #12/#13 runtime pieces are pending; this contract fixes the argv surface, exit codes, token discipline and terminal-restoration contract only, with no runtime claims

control_plane.rule: every command talks to the control plane only; the CLI never talks to a Runner directly (#76, runner-language ADR)
control_plane.direct_runner_flag_forbidden: no flag may route any command directly to a Runner; a direct_runner flag violates this contract and the verifier rejects it

global_flags.effect: suppress the telemetry summary line and other non-essential output

commands.name: login
commands.purpose: bootstrap the control-plane token: read the token from stdin (no echo) and store it in the token file
commands.no_oauth: no OAuth flow in this ticket (#14 本票不含); paste-a-token bootstrap only

commands.name: claude
commands.purpose: create a sandbox, clone the optional repo, and attach to a Claude terminal in one line
commands.repo_validation: same rule as scripts/clone_args.py validate_repo_url: https scheme only, host present, no userinfo, no whitespace or control characters; a rejected --repo is a usage error (64)

commands.name: ls
commands.purpose: list the caller's sandboxes with id and state

commands.name: connect
commands.purpose: attach the local terminal to an existing sandbox terminal

commands.name: suspend
commands.purpose: request a cold suspend of the sandbox via the control plane

commands.name: destroy
commands.purpose: explicitly destroy the sandbox and its files via the control plane

commands.name: exec
commands.purpose: run a command inside the sandbox and attach to its terminal
commands.literal_argv_rule: everything after -- is literal argv to the sandbox: never shell-parsed, never string-concatenated into a shell command line; argv passthrough mirrors the clone_args.py discipline

commands.name: cp
commands.purpose: download a file from the sandbox (download-only in M1; no upload in this ticket)
commands.implementation: the interface and exit codes are fixed here; the implementation lands with the #20 integration PR, not standalone in #14
commands.pre_implementation_behavior: until #20 lands the command exits 64 with a message pointing at #20; it never fakes or mocks a successful download

unsupported_commands.name: snapshot
unsupported_commands.message_template: unsupported command: {command} (not in the M1 minimal CLI; see sandbox --help)

unsupported_commands.name: fork
unsupported_commands.message_template: unsupported command: {command} (not in the M1 minimal CLI; see sandbox --help)

unsupported_commands.name: resume
unsupported_commands.message_template: unsupported command: {command} (not in the M1 minimal CLI; resume is a control-plane state operation reached via connect after the state endpoint reports Active)

exit_codes.meaning: success; also the Ctrl-\ detach exit: the attach ends and the sandbox keeps running
usage error, unknown command, or explicitly unsupported command
data error: invalid input data or an unusable control-plane response such as an unknown sandbox id
no token: the token file is missing or empty and SANDBOX_TOKEN is unset; run sandbox login
internal error (a bug); report it, do not retry blindly
temporary failure; retrying later may succeed
terminal connection lost: auto-reconnect attempts exhausted after a network drop; the message names the sandbox id to reconnect with

token.storage: single file, no other copies on disk

env_override.name: SANDBOX_TOKEN
env_override.purpose: CI and scripts: take the token from the environment instead of the file

terminal.raw_mode: while attached the CLI puts the local terminal into raw mode
terminal.detach_semantics: the attach ends with exit code 0 and the sandbox keeps running; nothing inside the sandbox is killed
terminal.network_drop: on a network drop the CLI auto-reconnects with backoff; when the attempts are exhausted it exits 76 with a message naming the sandbox id
terminal.cold_recovery: on attach after a cold suspend/resume the terminal answers wrong_generation or replays a new screen; the CLI prints an explicit NEW session notice and never presents the new session as the old one (#13)

telemetry.terminal_ready_ms: elapsed from the create request to terminal ready
telemetry.clone_done_ms: elapsed from clone start to clone completion; recorded only when --repo is used
telemetry.output: recorded locally as one line on stdout; nothing is uploaded in this ticket
telemetry.target_not_promise: 10 seconds is listed as the create-to-terminal-ready target, not a promise; clone time is outside our control and is never a hard commitment

release_requires.artifact: checksum file (sha256 of each release binary)

install_artifacts.platform_claims: a platform is claimed supported only after real testing on it

platforms.note: require real testing before any support claim

api_gaps: a missing control-plane capability answers with an explicit unsupported error, never a mocked success (issue #14 2026-10-02 note)
